tools.name: crypto_price_checker
tools.description: Fetches live cryptocurrency market prices, 24h change, and market cap in USD using the free CoinGecko API.

coin_id.description: Cryptocurrency ID (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, dogecoin)

tools.name: duckduckgo_search
tools.description: Searches the web via DuckDuckGo and returns top search results including titles, snippets, and URLs.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default 5)

tools.name: slack_notifier
tools.description: Sends rich markdown notifications and webhook alerts directly to Slack channels.

webhook_url.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL (or reads SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL env var)

tools.name: sqlite_query_runner
tools.description: Execute parameterized SQL queries, inspect table schemas, and fetch structured tabular results from SQLite databases safely with configurable read-only safeguards.

database_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3)

query.description: SQL query to execute (e.g. SELECT, PRAGMA table_info, EXPLAIN)

params.description: Optional list or tuple of positional parameters for parameterized SQL execution

read_only.description: Enforce read-only mode to prevent write/destructive operations (default: true)

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: 100)

returns.description: Query execution result containing columns, rows as key-value objects, row_count, execution_time_ms, and status

tools.name: wikipedia_search
tools.description: Searches Wikipedia and returns clean extract summaries, page titles, and canonical URLs for agent knowledge retrieval.

query.description: Topic or title to search on Wikipedia

sentences.description: Number of summary sentences to return (default 3)
